Our Culture

Why people choose to stay at OpenLM

We don’t just offer jobs — we offer an environment where great minds do their best work.

⚖️
Work-Life Balance

We're humans first. Flexible hours, no burnout culture, and a genuine mandate to unplug mean your best work happens within your whole life — not despite it.

🌍
Diverse Culture

From Shalom to Namaste, our team calls span hemispheres. We actively celebrate difference and believe the best solutions emerge from genuinely different perspectives.

🚪
Open-Door Policy

Have an idea? A concern? Reach anyone — CEO included. Our flat structure means great thinking doesn't get buried in hierarchy or bureaucracy.

⚡
Cutting-Edge Tech

We don't maintain legacy — we redefine industry. Expect to work with modern stacks, tackle hard engineering problems, and see your ideas ship to real customers fast.

🏛️
GSA Contract Holder

Our products meet rigorous environmental, socioeconomic, and compliance standards. You'll be proud of what you build and who you build it for.

🤝
Flat Structure

No siloes. No gatekeepers. Management and HR are genuinely accessible, and collaboration happens across every team, every time zone, every function.

Workstations are too mainstream - we have PerkStations

Join us to perk up yourself!

Flexible Shifts

Work according to your time zones.

No Overtime Policy

Strictly 8-hours of work with 1-hour break.

Don’t Party Hard, But Harder

Mandatory annual vacation for all.

Excited? Drop in your CV at hr@openlm.com and join us in our thrilling journey!
You can also apply through our LinkedIN page.
